Measured the foreground streetlight from its base to its highest point and applied the local ground-plane scale.

Measured the pedestrian’s head-to-foot pixel height and converted with the depth-corrected scale.
Tracked the bicycle across the frames, converted its pixel displacement using its depth, and divided by elapsed time.
